baseline.method: Reverse only production execution-machine diff, reproduce exact predecessor bytes, run identical final tests, restore and rebuild.
baseline.controls: Both binding-fork orders, permissive omitted inspection, and independent GC metadata access.

conformance.limitation: Concrete WeakRef/yield selection does not verify checkpoint discovery. Previous212 spread/tagged-template reports remain historical; existing tail-call failures are not reclassified.

forks.scope: Native captured counter restoration and original completion values; not general heap ownership.

react.inspectedSource: ReactFiberHooks.js state dispatch closure binding, separate from Agent notification protocol.
react.result: Reject caller-supplied completion notification at actual React pause before its metadata is expanded by discovery; preserve exact error/pause and no open checkpoint.

contract.order: For non-control object: iterate owner references, record/retain each returned value, read current capture manifest and bindings, enqueue copied owner references after metadata references.
contract.descendantPriority: Original LIFO owner-edge priority preserved, but root-array insertion and direct inspection/metadata ordering change.
contract.failures: Owner callback/iterator failures precede direct metadata access; no checkpoint publication, temporary roots release, exact exception retained. Trusted effects are not rolled back.
contract.garbageCollection: Agent-managed live discovery-root array retains references before later metadata GC and through partial iterator failure. Standalone control capture still requires explicit retention.

retainedFindings: First expanded typecheck failed TS7022/TS7023 for self-referencing callback/getter; explicit unknown getter return type fixed inference. Focused runtime tests had passed.
Read-only review suggested partial iterator.next failure and mixed-edge ordering tests. Added both; separated root retention from pending enqueue to preserve original descendant priority.
Final read-only review found no root/order defect, without running gates.
GC in beginCapture can execute metadata before later owner rejection. Partial-iterator GC likewise invokes metadata independently; tested counts distinguish it from direct discovery.
limitations: No whole-graph preflight: parent metadata may run before descendant rejection.
No private automatic owner; missing references still conflates unexamined values with leaves.
No gate on GC marking, direct getNativeCaptures, control-frame callbacks, restore getters/setters, or future calls/allocations/effects.
Native source provenance is not complete capture/storage/effect ownership. Host callbacks and reflection remain trusted.
No general React isolation, automatic guarded reports, transitions, repeated-state families, or demo integration.
